changeinfo.changes: Introduces the new offline mode in MONOPOLY DEAL, allowing players to play against their friends or up to 4 AI using their second screen. Also fixes some bugs.

Introduces the new picture taking feature in My MONOPOLY allowing players to take pictures to make their My Monopoly board even more personal. Adds the customized texts in the MONOPOLY Rabbids DLC. Fixes some bugs in Monopoly Plus.
